definitions: Made a short, sharp, loud sound, characteristic of a dog.
Spoke in a short, sharp, and often angry or impatient tone.
Removed the bark from a tree or log.
Scraped skin off a part of the body, typically a shin or elbow, by hitting it against something hard.
examples: The dog barked loudly at the postman.
He barked an order at his subordinates.
They barked the logs before milling them.
She barked her shin on the coffee table.
